title: Detailed cupcake
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='frost' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffb3de'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#ff7fc4'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='wrap' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffd98a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#e8a94a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- wrapper -->
  <path d='M22 52 L78 52 L70 92 Q70 96 66 96 L34 96 Q30 96 30 92 Z' fill='url(#wrap)'/>
  <!-- wrapper ridges -->
  <path d='M30 58 L34 94' stroke='#c98a32' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M40 56 L41 95' stroke='#c98a32' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M50 55 L50 95' stroke='#c98a32' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M60 56 L59 95' stroke='#c98a32' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M70 58 L66 94' stroke='#c98a32' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- cake top edge -->
  <rect x='20' y='46' width='60' height='9' rx='4' fill='#f0b95c'/>
  <!-- frosting swirl -->
  <path d='M20 50 Q18 30 30 28 Q28 16 42 16 Q46 6 58 10 Q70 8 72 20 Q84 22 80 34 Q86 44 76 50 Z' fill='url(#frost)'/>
  <!-- frosting highlight -->
  <path d='M34 40 Q32 30 42 28 Q46 22 54 24' stroke='#ffd6ec' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 38 Q70 36 74 28' stroke='#ffd6ec' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cherry -->
  <circle cx='52' cy='12' r='8' fill='#e8324a'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='9' r='2.5' fill='#ff8fa3'/>
  <path d='M52 4 Q56 -2 62 0' stroke='#4fa84f' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sprinkles -->
  <rect x='30' y='34' width='6' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#4aa8ff' transform='rotate(-25 33 35)'/>
  <rect x='60' y='38' width='6' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#ffe14a' transform='rotate(35 63 39)'/>
  <rect x='44' y='42' width='6' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#7be36a' transform='rotate(15 47 43)'/>
  <rect x='66' y='24' width='6' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#4aa8ff' transform='rotate(-40 69 25)'/>
  <rect x='40' y='24' width='6' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#ffffff' transform='rotate(50 43 25)'/>
  <rect x='54' y='30' width='6' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#ff9a3d' transform='rotate(-15 57 31)'/>
</svg>
